claimChanges.claimText: AyudantIA is listed for Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile (UC) in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.
UC's academic-integrity guidance recommends avoiding generative-AI detection tools because their reliability has not been demonstrated and false positives can significantly affect students.
When instructors allow generative AI use, UC guidance tells them to promote personal-data protection by avoiding feeding AI tools names, grades, or other private or sensitive information.

UC's academic-integrity guidance says instructors should clearly and transparently determine permitted and prohibited uses of generative AI, and treats unauthorized AI use in a course as an academic-integrity violation.
UC guidance asks instructors to register and publish in Canvas the specific course or discipline agreements and limits for using AI systems and applications.
UC's Docencia con IA guidance frames AI-supported teaching around deep learning, human dignity, inclusion, academic integrity, ethical responsibility, and data security/privacy.
